item.text:
**Conclusion:** The supplied data do not support a positive vmPFC gain effect at whole-brain FWE p < .05. In the 54 participants, the smallest vmPFC voxelwise FWE p was .162; the descriptive regional mean was 0.0003 cope units (95% t interval −0.0140 to 0.0145). Corrected positive voxels appeared in posterior regions, outside the hypothesis region.

The concise report explains the group model, vmPFC localization, effect-map interpretation, quality checks, uncertainty, and limitations, following the [original NARPS instructions](https://www.narps.info/files/narps_instructions_for_analysis_teams.pdf).
